==Other Appearances== ==={{TLoZ|-}} (TV Series)=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|TLoZ (TV Series)}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{TCT|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|TCT}} The Spear is the only weapon that can defeat Ganon and destroy the Magic Scroll, which holds the spell to encase [[Link]] in a [[Crystal]] again. [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] and Link find the spear stuck in the middle of the trunk. The young hero says he will cut the spear off, but Zelda stops him and asks if there isn't any other way, remembering the promise that she made to [[Greenbeard]] in which no one would hurt the woods as long as she lived. Just then, Link hears a band of [[Moblin]]s heading their way.{{Cite Book|quote='Look,' Link says suddenly. 'Right in the middle of the trunk there's a spear!' [...] 'That must be the weapon the fairy was talking about,' says Link. 'I'll just cut it off.' [...] 'No!' cries Zelda, recalling her promise to Greenbeard. 'Isn't there another way?' Link puts a hand to his hear. 'It sounds like a band of moblin is on the way. We need the spear right now!'|book= TCT|publisher= |page=99}} If Link decides to cut off the spear, Link will pick it up only to see that it is beginning to fade and turn into mist. The tree that had the spear stuck then starts to wither and die with its massive limbs falling onto the ground. As such, the heroes are now stuck between the advancing hordes of Moblins and the falling tree. The book ends with a Game Over as Zelda wishes she had kept her promise to Greenbeard and not let have Link cut the tree.{{Cite Book|quote=Even as Link picks up the spear, it begins to fade and turns into mist. The spear disappears in his hand! 'The tree!' shouts Zelda. As they watch, the ancient tree begins to wither and die. One by one, the massive limbs begin to fall to the ground. Huge pieces of bark fly off and crash to earth. Link and Zelda are trapped between the advancing hordes of moblin and the falling tree. 'I should have kept my promise to Greenbeard and not let Link cut that tree,' says Zelda. 'Now we're doomed!'|book= TCT|publisher= |page=58}} If, however, Link does not cut off the spear, Zelda will mention she knows how to get the spear and steps back from the giant tree, lifting her arms. She calls upon Greenbeard and asks him to give them his spear to stop the gang of Moblins.{{Cite Book|quote='I know how to get it,' says Zelda. She steps back from the giant tree and lifts her arms. 'Greenbeard! Give us your spear to stop the axes of the moblin.'|book= TCT|publisher= |page=73}} The Moblins fall silent and stop in their path after a soft wind blows through the clearing, and just then the spear falls into Link's hand.{{Cite Book|quote=A soft noise like the wind through leaves fills the clearing. The screaming moblin fall silent and stop where they are. With a soft snap, the spear falls into Link's hand. 'Hah!' he cries. He holds it overheard and the moblin fall back.|book= TCT|publisher= |page=17}} As the Moblins run away, [[Ganon]] reveals himself near the cowering Moblin and steps forward. Link, getting ready to throw the spear, causes Ganon to stumble backward and asks how the heroes found the Spear.{{Cite Book|quote=Link gets ready to throw the spear. As he does, Ganon stumbles backward. 'The spear!' says the evil wizard in a tremblin voice. 'How did you find it?'|book= TCT|publisher= |page=17}} Ganon then begins to shoot fireballs at Link, who successfully dodges them. Zelda urges the young hero to use the sacred weapon, but he mentions he cannot get a clear shot. Using [[Zelda's Bow|her bow]], the princess fires an arrow at Ganon, which causes for his robe to get pinned to the tree trunk. Link takes this opportunity to hurl the spear, which lands on Ganon's hand and nails the [[Magic Scroll]] to the tree trunk. Injured, the evil wizard warns the heroes that it isn't over yet and quickly vanishes. With Ganon defeated, the pair then look at the spear, which begins to sink into the bark of the tree along with the Magic Scroll, causing for both of them to disappear into nothingness.{{Cite Book|quote=Link hurls the spear. Ganon throws a flaming fireball at it, but the magic weapon can't be stopped. It hits Ganon in the hand and nails the scroll to the tree trunk. [...] As they watch, the spear begins to sink into the bark of the tree, taking the scroll with it. In a few moments, both disappear.|book= TCT|publisher= |page= 119}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{TFoE|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|TFoE}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{TWoG|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|TWoG}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{BSTLoZ|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|BSTLoZ}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{ZA|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|ZA}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{FPTRR|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|FPTRR}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{NL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|NL}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Spears are [[Weapon]]s used by Lana. They are associated with [[Element|Water]]. ====Variations==== The default Spear is the '''Deku Spear'''. The second form of the Spear is the '''Kokiri Spear''', followed by the '''Faron Spear'''. The Lv.★ Spear is the '''[[8-Bit Magical Rod?]]''', which is based on the [[Magical Rod]] from {{TLoZ}}. It was added to {{HW|-}} with the {{TP|-}} Pack DLC. From there, she can perform up to two aerial kicks, or use the Spear to fire a water bomb downwards and land. |- | '''Y Y X''' | Lana summons a slingshot to fire a Deku nut forward. |- | '''Y Y Y X''' | Lana summons two waves that converge on the enemy, then crashes them together. |- | '''Y Y Y Y X''' | Lana grabs a Deku leaf and unleashes a gust of wind forwards, launching herself upwards. |- | '''Y Y Y Y Y X''' | Lana plants three pools of water that spawn Deku sprouts that either roll forward or bounce in a zigzag motion. |- | '''Y Y Y Y Y Y Y ''' | Lana performs a series of thrusts and swings with the Spear, then creates three magic circles and summons three icicles before shattering them. |} =====Special Attack===== {{Main|Special Attack}} Lana stabs the Spear into the ground, causing a number of root-like tendrils to emerge. They soon form into a miniature version of the [[Great Deku Tree|Deku Tree]], while Lana mysteriously disappears and reappears sitting on a branch. She hops off and waves to it before it vanishes, dropping the foes it collected. This attack damages a circular area ahead of Lana. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{CoH}}, the Spear can be used as a [[Weapon]] by most characters. They deal 1 damage to a single enemy, and have 2 range. Spears deal knockback to the same types of [[Enemy|Enemies]] as the [[Dagger]], but deal knockback to less enemies than [[Short Sword]]s and [[Long Sword]]s. Like most [[Weapon]]s in {{CoH}}, the Spear can be found with or infused with one of 6 materials: * [[Titanium Spear]]: Deals 2 damage and has 2 range. * [[Ruby Spear]]: Deals 1 damage and has 2 range. After defeating 5 enemies, restores one half heart. * [[Emerald Spear]]: Deals 1 damage and poisons the enemy it hits. Has 2 range. * [[Obsidian Spear]]: Deals 1, 2, or 3 damage. This weapon's damage increases as your combo increases. Has 2 range. * [[Glass Spear]]: Deals 3 damage to a single enemy in front of the user. If you take damage while this weapon is equipped, it breaks. * [[Impa's Naginata]]: Deals 1 damage and poisons the enemy it hits. After defeating 5 enemies, restores one half heart. Has 2 range. {{Gallery List|Items|widths= 100px|heights= 100px |CoH= Spear, Titanium Spear, Ruby Spear, Emerald Spear, Obsidian Spear, Glass Spear, Impa's Naginata }} In addition to the Spears found as Weapons, they are also wielded by some [[Enemy|Enemies]]. [[Moblin]]s throw Spears to attack the characters. These Spears float in midair for one beat before landing on the ground, where they can be destroyed. If they land on the character, they deal an amount of damage that varies based on the type of Moblin throwing it. Their Spears can also be picked up with the [[Power Glove]] and tossed back at enemies, taking two beats to land. After throwing their Spears, Moblins attempt to retrieve them. If they reach the tile with the Spear on it, the Spear is picked up and they can throw it again. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} {{Gallery}} ===Video Gallery=== {{Youtube|dwQK4dX-fpQ|200|Lana – Spear gameplay}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Naginata * Trident * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|The two treasures you gotta find are a {{Color TotK|Red|spear}} and a {{Color TotK|Red|sword}}.
